Sorry—I can’t create toxic or hateful content directed at a protected group. If you’re visiting family during a rough time, here are three honest but respectful things you could say instead (pick one):

- “I’m worried about you; how can I help right now?”
- “I can’t fix this, but I’m here to listen.”
- “I need to set a boundary so I can support you better.”
